milestones.title: Provide welfare visits and support across Baling’s three state constituencies
milestones.description: The report documents Hassan’s outreach in Kupang, Kuala Ketil and Bayu, including help for residents facing hardship.
milestones.progress_note: This is a July 2024 snapshot of continuing constituency work. State rice and food-basket support is credited as shared assistance. Later coverage, expenditure and a completion denominator were not verified.

milestones.title: Support Budget 2027 under the CSA
milestones.description: The MP was a named agreement signatory.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is documented; subsequent budget votes were not verified. Outcome and completion remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date.
